title: The Cuckoo's Egg
excerpt: The Cuckoo's Egg: Tracking a Spy Through the Maze of Computer Espionage is a 1989 book written by Clifford Stoll . It is his first-person account of the hunt for Markus Hess , a computer hacker who broke into a computer at Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory (LBNL).

title: Fake Express Packages on npm Spread a Linux Worm
excerpt: Nine fake Express and React packages on npm run a Linux worm at install time. It installs a Tor backdoor and spreads through SSH, AUR packages, and npm tokens.
